title: Grateful Dead Live at Hollywood Palladium on 1972-09-09
lineage: 1st generation reels (Technics 1506) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp (24/96) > Adobe Audition CC 2020 > TLH flac2496
source: Master Soundboard Cassettes (Uher deck) > Will Boswell's 1st generation reels @3.75 ips

ai_review.summary: Jam‑filled performance on a decent‑quality soundboard tape that still sounds good after 50 years.
ai_review.review: The reviewers rave about the abundance of jams and a solid setlist, calling it a “nice show.” The recording, though five decades old, is praised for its pleasant sound and decent mix, suggesting a respectable soundboard source. Overall the release is viewed as a well‑executed snapshot of the Dead’s improvisational spirit.

ai_rating.rationale: A single five‑star review highlights both strong musical performance and acceptable recording quality; weighting favors the show, yielding a high overall rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Decent mix and pleasant sound for a tape over 50 years old; no major flaws mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Good set list with many enjoyable jams, though no specific songs are called out.
